title: Derandomizing Karger's Contraction Algorithm for Matroids
summary: Karger's randomized contraction algorithm finds a minimum-weight cocircuit of a matroid whenever the cogirth-density ratio is bounded. We prove that the same hypothesis yields a deterministic algorithm with the same exponent. If every contraction minor of rank at least $r_0$ of a matroid $M$ has cogirth-density ratio at most $c$, then a minimum-weight cocircuit of $M$ is computable deterministically in $m^{O(r_0)} n^{O(c)}$ time when the contraction minors of bounded rank have at most $m$ parallel classes, by an algorithm that knows neither $r_0$ nor $c$.
